events.text: A Jenner guards the relay approach. Engage the raider?
The approach is secure. Return to the depot for your payment.
You withdraw from the relay. The contract remains open.
The lance cannot deploy here. Return to the depot.
The depot offers machines and basic repairs.
The lance is repaired.
You cannot afford repairs.
Your machines need no repairs.

Argent Recovery. Two data caches lie east along the road. Survey the relay north of the road, then return to the western landing pad. Your Phoenix Hawk and Trebuchet can challenge the raider in the east. The southern pad abandons the contract.
Mission command rejected. No counter or terminal objective was changed.
First cache uploaded. One more remains along the road to the east.
Both caches secured. Survey the northern relay, then bring the data to the western pad.
Relay survey complete. The landing pad can now authenticate both data caches.
Extraction requires both caches and the northern relay survey. Follow the road east; the relay is above its midpoint.
Both caches and the relay survey are secure. Payment received. The depot now needs you to protect the upload vehicle.
You withdraw without the data. The extraction contract has failed. Your surviving lance can seek another employer.
A raider guards the eastern approach. Engage?
The eastern approach is clear. Recover the data and return to the landing pad.
Your lance breaks contact. The caches and relay remain available; retreat from this skirmish does not cancel the contract.
Mission command could not be completed. Check the mission log and deployment area.
Hold for 5 rounds. A Galleon guards the relay vehicle. Raiders approach from the northeast. Losing the vehicle or retreating fails the contract.
A second raider is entering the valley. The relay upload is still running.
The reinforcements cannot deploy yet. They will try again next round.
The relay contract has failed. The surviving crew evacuates without its data.
Keep the Skulker alive. It follows the marked road around the depot to the northeast landing pad. Raiders can attack the transport. The crew drives; you control the two escort mechs.
Movement detected east of the depot. Keep the carrier covered.
The ambush is delayed. Watch the eastern approach.
The transport did not reach the landing zone. The escort contract has failed.

Greybank Dispatch. A raider lance has cut this outpost off from its DropShip. Rowan pilots a Phoenix Hawk; Mira brings a Trebuchet. Visit the contract office north of the road. The workshop to the east sells machines and repairs your lance.
The contract could not advance. Check the mission journal and regroup at the depot.
Visit the contract office. The dispatcher arranges your next deployment.
Choose one opening contract. Either opens the route for the convoy; the other will be left to the local militia.
A Jenner blocks the relay approach. Take the south road, clear the patrol and return here. Payment: 4,000 C-bills. Retreat leaves this contract open.
Take the south road. Upload two caches, survey the northern relay, then return to the western extraction pad. Payment: 4,000 C-bills. The raider patrol is optional.
Your lance cannot hold the approach. The militia evacuates Greybank. Contract failed.
The next contract pays 3,000 C-bills. Protect the relay vehicle for 5 rounds. Repair at the workshop before deploying.
Upload complete; payment received. Return to the workshop for repairs, then ask the dispatcher to begin the escort.
Escort the Skulker through the pass for 4,000 C-bills. Keep it alive until it reaches the landing pad. This is the last contract.
The Skulker reaches the DropShip with the traffic logs. Payment received. Report to the depot dispatcher to close the campaign.
Greybank is back on the network. Your lance has brought the convoy home.
Greybank Dispatch complete. The DropShip lifts off with the recovered traffic logs. Your lance has earned its next contract. Press Space to finish.

objectives.text: Defeat the Jenner and return to the depot.
objectives.title: Clear the relay approach

objectives.text: Cross both marked caches on the east road. Each cache counts once.
objectives.title: Recover two caches

objectives.text: Reach the marked relay north of the road.
objectives.title: Survey the relay

objectives.text: With both caches and the survey, return to the western landing pad. The southern pad abandons this contract.
objectives.title: Extract the data

objectives.text: Keep the relay vehicle alive for 5 rounds.
objectives.title: Hold the relay

objectives.text: Keep the Skulker alive until it reaches the landing pad.
objectives.title: Escort the carrier
